Interface TypeName

All Known Implementing Classes:
ArrayTypeName, ClassName, ParameterizedTypeName, PrimitiveTypeName, TypeVariableName, WildcardTypeName
public sealed interface TypeName permits ArrayTypeName, ClassName, ParameterizedTypeName, PrimitiveTypeName, TypeVariableName, WildcardTypeName
The name of a type as it is written in source code: a primitive, a class, a parameterized type, an array, a type variable or a wildcard, possibly with type annotations such as @Nullable.

Type names are values: two names of the same type, with the same annotations, are equal.

  • Method Details

    • of

      static TypeName of(Class<?> type)
      Returns the name of a class, which may be primitive, void or an array.
      Parameters:
      type - the class
      Returns:
      its name
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the class is local or anonymous, and has no canonical name

    • of

      static TypeName of(Type type)
      Returns the name of a type obtained by reflection, such as the generic type of a field: a class, a parameterized type, a generic array, a type variable or a wildcard.

      An inner class whose enclosing type has type arguments, as in Outer<String>.Inner, is named with a owner type. A reflective type carries no type annotations, so the name has none.

      Parameters:
      type - the type
      Returns:
      its name
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the type is or refers to a local or anonymous class, or it is none of the kinds of Type above

    • of

      static TypeName of(TypeMirror type)
      Returns the name of a type, with its type annotations.

      An inner class whose enclosing type has type arguments or annotations, as in Outer<String>.Inner, is named with a owner type.

      Parameters:
      type - the type
      Returns:
      its name
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the type has no name, such as an executable, a package or a local or anonymous class; or it is an error type whose name cannot be guessed as ClassName.bestGuess(String) guesses it

      default TypeName unbox()
      Returns the primitive type of a boxed type, such as int for Integer, with the same annotations; a primitive type unchanged. Void unboxes to void, as void boxes to Void.

      Throws:
